To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the existence of an adequate corporate strategy definition and the proper definition and implementation of department strategies in the areas of marketing, technology, finance and human resources are all related to the enterprise size, measured in terms of turnover and number of employees.

(a) there is a relationship, albeit a weak one, between enterprise size and the existence of a functional department strategy; (b) there is no direct relationship between the definition of the corporate strategy and that of the functional department strategies; and (c) the corporate strategy is related to the functional department strategies of the marketing and technology areas, and the functional department strategies are related to each other.

1) the existence of a corporate strategy definition has an effect on the existence of functional strategies in the technology and human resources departments; 2) enterprise size, measured by turnover, affects the proper definition of functional strategies in technology, human resources, and finance areas; 3) enterprise size, determined in terms of number of employees, affects the proper formulation of a corporate strategy and the definition of technology, finance, and human resources department strategies.
In summary, our research is concerned with
a study of the links that can exist between corporate strategy, the four functional areas and the policies conducted by the four departments.

establishing the presence or absence of a link between the existence of logical corporate strategies and their links to functional strategies in four areas: marketing, technology, personnel and finance.
establishing the relationship between enterprise size and the existence of functional strategies in small and medium-sized Spanish hotels.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

, in the case of small and medium-sized Spanish hotels, the existence of a global strategy is related to the existence of functional strategies in the areas of marketing, technology, finance and human resources.

there is a clear relationship between the size of the enterprise, as measured by business turnover and number of employees, with a logical global definition of corporate strategy, and between the size of a company and a logical definition of functional or department strategies.

, in Spanish small and middle-sized hotels, a logical global strategy exists, and this strategy is linked to the policies conducted by the marketing and technology departments and to the policies conducted in the areas of human resource and finance.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the existence of a corporate strategy is not enough to guarantee that functional strategies are also in place.
there is a direct relationship between enterprise size and the definition of functional department policies and between corporate strategies and the definition of departmental policies.
there is a logical relationship between the definition of the corporate strategy and the definition of department strategies.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the existence of corporate strategy is related to the existence of department strategies, which is a finding that is consistent with the results of other authors who have conducted research in the tourism sector and with those of other studies conducted in other business sectors.
